subject: Marine Works - Gulf - Port au Port - north - Harrington Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Gulf - Port au Port - north - Harrington Harbour
Hydro line reconstruction work with floating dock installation taking place daily during daylight hours between Harrington Harbour and Chevery. Work barges and safety boats on scene and monitoring VHF 16.
Minimum wake and wide berth requested.
                                                    Cancels NW-C-3025-26
